name: Tonianne J. Bongiovanni
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed April 14, 2003 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 2.

biography.text: Bongiovanni earned a B.S. from Jersey City State College, now New Jersey City University (1980), and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1988). She has served as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge since 2003 and has taught as an adjunct at Seton Hall Law.
